description: Regression guard for a broad Next.js audit with distinct Phase, React performance, and Next.js findings.
expectedBehavior: Treats the unexplained page-performance request as a combined audit and uses the neutral Page performance audit title
Runs installed companions whose capabilities cover React client performance and Next.js framework behavior, and records the exact skills used
Keeps the CSS-hidden canvas loop under Phase because the mounted subtree continues browser work while hidden
Keeps the client barrel import and whole-store subscription under React performance instead of claiming Phase bundle or re-render ownership
Keeps the independent sequential server fetches under Next.js best practices instead of improvising a Phase data recommendation
Returns full findings under Phase, React performance, and Next.js sections, with one audit owner on every action
Does not force a global priority order without common measurement or a clear causal dependency
Makes no bundle-size, hydration-cost, or runtime-savings claim without the matching companion evidence or a performance trace
